title: Helicity-supported stationary spacetimes: A class of finite-energy, horizonless, axisymmetric solutions
summary: We construct a class of stationary, axisymmetric, horizonless spacetimes whose curvature is generated entirely by smooth, localised differential rotation $Ω(r)$, while the spatial geometry remains exactly flat. Despite vanishing ADM mass, these helicity-supported configurations exhibit non-trivial curvature, finite tidal forces, and a gravitomagnetic field arising from the radial shear of the rotation.
